text:
Trump called democratic socialism the "biggest threat to the nation since its founding"(Image: Samuel Corum - Pool via CNP/Shutterstock)

President Donald Trump slammed democratic socialist candidates on Monday, claiming their movement represents a more serious threat to the United States than previous world wars and the Sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks.

"They use the word social democrat because it sounds so nice, but it's really communism you're talking about," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office.

"I think it's the biggest threat to our nation there is, maybe since our founding," he said. "That includes World War I, World War II, September 11, it includes the Pearl Harbor attack."

The president has consistently sounded the alarm about democratic socialist candidates securing electoral victories since New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani assumed office earlier this year.

This marked the second occasion in recent days that he made the assertion publicly. "The House of Representatives has approved this vital Act, THREE TIMES," Trump wrote as he attempts to promote the Save America Act to voters, reports the Mirror US.

"The United States Senate seems unable to do so. In a time when there is a powerful Communist Movement taking place in our Country, one more dangerous than World War I, World War II, Pearl Harbor, or September 11th."

On Friday, Trump shared a rambling post on Truth Social before arriving at the Washington Hilton Hotel - the same venue where he narrowly escaped an assassination attempt earlier this year. He was scheduled to address the Faith and Freedom Coalition's annual Road to Majority Conference in Washington, D.C.

Prior to his appearance, he delivered an almost 350-word tirade about what he described as the rising danger of "communism" in America.

"I will be making, perhaps the most important of them all, concerns the recent Election of Communists in our Country. Communism is very easy to sell. I'd be the Greatest Communist in History," he wrote, asserting that under communism, he would offer free housing and food.

"Unfortunately, after two or three years, the Country where this is taking place would fail. It always does, and then you'll start living in squalor. There will be no food, there will be no housing, there will be no Military, there will be no nothing. You'll be Third World every way, and everyone will suffer or die."

Trump made bold claims about the dangers of democratic socialism(Image: SAUL LOEB, AFP via Getty Images)

He also contended following the recent primary election night that these candidates secure backing by making empty pledges, while the "Dumocrats" lack the resolve to challenge them.

"They're not smart enough or tough enough to fight this plague. If they fought them the way they fight Republicans, or me, they'd be victorious, but they don't have the courage to do so," he said.

Trump then maintained that communists pose a danger to all faiths and that Christianity, in particular, faces significant peril.

"They will close your Churches, they will kill your people. This is what they're about. This is the Greatest Threat to our Country since its Founding 250 years ago!" he declared. Trump subsequently gave a keynote speech at the Faith and Freedom Coalition's annual Road to Majority Conference, hosted at the same hotel where the third purported assassination attempt against him took place during the White House Correspondents' Dinner.

On that occasion, he was rapidly removed from the venue after gunfire was reported.
